basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of Sunnyside, 348 Edna Street is a beautifully renovated gem that perfectly blends modern upgrades with classic charm. Situated on a spacious corner lot, this sun-drenched home has been thoughtfully designed for today's lifestyle. Enjoy peace of mind with an updated foundation, brand-new roof, and fully upgraded electrical and plumbing systems. The modern kitchen boasts all-new, top-of-the-line appliances, while a new furnace and energy-efficient tankless water heater provide year-round comfort. Offering three bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and a versatile family room, the layout is ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. Step outside to a newly built deck overlooking a freshly landscaped backyard, perfect for outdoor gatherings. A dedicated washer/dryer space with hook-ups adds convenience. All renovations were completed with permits, currently awaiting final inspection. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a fully upgraded home in the highly sought-after Sunnyside neighborhood!
